verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server enabling Claude/Cursor/Copilot and other AI agents to query metrics, logs, traces, and alerts via natural language, plus published 'Agent Skills' and explicit use cases like 'Dashboard Creation from Natural Language' and 'Investigate What Changed After a Deploy'. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming the MCP/natural-language workflow works reliably in practice, and coverage of edge cases beyond documented use cases.
